{{Quote|I was told that you were well paid for your loyalty. Tell me what you know about Imperial activity on Cloud City."''<br />''"Here's what I can tell you. I've looked at both sides of the situation, and I've decided that the Imperials will pay me even more credits when all you Rebels are killed! Get 'em, boys!|A Rebel operative and Yoxgit|<ref name="TPoV" />}}
'''Yoxgit''' was an [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] whose [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. A security systems [[Technician/Legends|technician]] with the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Company/Legends|company]] [[A'roFilter]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]&mdash;a mining colony that floated in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of Bespin&mdash;he was discontent with the amount of money he made at his job. Eventually, Yoxgit began secretly supplying [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] gas to [[Hermi Odle/Legends|Hermi Odle]], a [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwin]] weapons designer working for a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Due to his criminal activities, Yoxgit was able to afford fashionable [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]], a [[chrome]]-plated [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car]], and an upper city apartment. By the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Occupation of Bespin|takeover]] of Cloud City in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Yoxgit led a gang of Ugnaughts and was a contact of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. During the Imperial occupation, Yoxgit aided in [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|freezing]] the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and Alliance [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] under the orders of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who commanded the occupying Imperial forces. Shortly thereafter, Yoxgit was forced to reveal the details surrounding the capture of Captain Solo after he and his gang unsuccessfully attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] a group of Rebels who came to him for information on the Imperial occupation.

Following these events, he realized that he would no longer be able to enjoy his new lifestyle, and he chose to leave Bespin for the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Jabba's seat of power. Once on Tatooine, Odle assigned him to maintain Jabba's security systems and observe the movements of the Baragwin's [[Skrilling/Legends|Skrilling]] nemesis, [[Pote Snitkin/Legends|Pote Snitkin]], as well as Snitkin's [[Yuzzum/Legends|Yuzzum]] minion, [[Wam Lufba/Legends|Wam Lufba]]. Due to his proficiency with his work, the Ugnaught found his way into Jabba's favor, and was invited to witness the execution of [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|three prisoners]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] from the [[Luxury-class sail barge|sail barge]] [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']]. Unfortunately for Jabba and Yoxgit, the prisoners escaped and [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|turned the tables]] on the crime lord's guards, while Jabba was slain by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], a friend of the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]. In the hopes of keeping his life of ease, Yoxgit prepared to kill Organa to curry favor with Jabba's successor, but he was killed when one of the prisoners, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], destroyed the ''Khetanna'' with the vehicle's [[Blaster cannon/Legends|deck cannon]].

==Biography==
===Early career===
[[File:Yoxgit-PoV.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Yoxgit on Cloud City]]
Calling [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] home, Yoxgit was employed on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] as a security systems technician with the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] company [[A'roFilter]]. He chose not to fraternize with his fellow [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]], and detested his honest endeavors, and so Yoxgit opted to make a few [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in an under-the-table scheme. He bartered illegal weaponry for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]<ref name="TPoV">{{SWGTCG|set=The Price of Victory|cardname=Yoxgit}}</ref> and also covertly sold [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] gas packs to [[Hermi Odle/Legends|Hermi Odle]], a [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwin]] weapons designer in the employ of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]. Odle, in turn, utilized the gas in [[Blaster power pack/Legends|blaster packs]]. With his supplementary profits from the deals with Odle, Yoxgit purchased an upper level apartment, far from his fellow working class Ugnaughts, a [[chrome]]-plated [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car]], and new, more fashionable clothes than his standard fatigues.<ref name="db" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Occupation of Bespin|seized control]] of Cloud City from [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].<ref name="esb">{{Film|V}}</ref> Yoxgit was paid a large sum of credits by the Rebel Alliance to gather information on Imperial activity on the mining colony. He arranged to meet Alliance representatives in a Cloud City cantina to provide the requested data. Yoxgit instead tried to double-cross the agent, but he and his Ugnaught thugs were unable to capture the Rebels. At the point of a blaster, Yoxgit stated that the Empire was already occupying Cloud City after making a deal with Calrissian. He also revealed that [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] had been frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] and was being turned over to the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. The Rebels then departed to try and rescue Solo.<ref name="TPOV">[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game|''Star Wars Galaxies'' Trading Card Game]]: ''[[The Price of Victory]]'' light side scenario</ref>

Predicting that he would not be able to maintain his current lifestyle under Imperial rule, Yoxgit bought a ticket for an outbound [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], which took him to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Jabba's center of operations, to call in his favors with Odle. The Baragwin hired the Ugnaught to tend to the security system he had devised for [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]. Yoxgit was also to keep an eye on Odle's rival, gunrunner [[Pote Snitkin/Legends|Pote Snitkin]], and his henchman, [[Wam Lufba/Legends|Wam Lufba]].<ref name="db" /> In addition to those roles, Yoxgit would supply Odle with various weaponry.<ref name="ccg">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Yoxgit}}</ref>

===Death at the Great Pit of Carkoon===
The following year, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] came to Jabba's Palace to rescue [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], a captive of the crime lord and a friend of theirs. They failed, and were in turn placed in Jabba's custody. While the Hutt chose to have Organa as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] girl, he sentenced Skywalker, Chewbacca, and Solo to [[Death/Legends|death]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]].<ref name="rotj">{{Film|VI}}</ref> Jabba was so pleased with Yoxgit's work on the security system that he invited the Ugnaught to accompany the rest of his court to the execution, aboard the [[Luxury-class sail barge|sail barge]] [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']]. Yoxgit accepted, believing that he was close to becoming one of Jabba's most favored employees.<ref name="db" />

[[File:Yoxgit.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Yoxgit in Jabba's Palace]]
The Ugnaught drank with the rest of the court, and wagered on the order of the executions.<ref name="db" /> However, when Skywalker was moved into position to be executed, the Jedi turned the tables on Jabba's guards, producing a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and assaulting the various executioners. His allies, including Calrissian, who had been disguised as a guard, began attacking Jabba's men, leading to widespread chaos [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|above]] the Great Pit of Carkoon.<ref name="rotj" /> Yoxgit, fearing for his own safety, hid behind the bar, and watched as Organa strangled Jabba to death with the chain the Hutt had used to control her. As Organa fled the scene, he realized that his hopes of an easy life in the criminal underworld were slipping away. He then picked up a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], hoping to kill Organa and cement his favor with whomever succeeded Jabba; but at that moment, Skywalker fired the ''Khetanna''{{'s}} [[Blaster cannon/Legends|deck cannon]] at the sail barge itself, killing Yoxgit in the blast.<ref name="db" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Yoxgit_uniform.jpg|thumb|left|Yoxgit in his Cloud City engineering uniform]]
While living at Cloud City, Yoxgit had nothing but disdain for both his working-class lifestyle and his fellow Ugnaughts, prompting him to turn to criminal activities to escape both.<ref name="db" /> He considered himself to be an upper-class citizen of the floating city.<ref name="TPoV" /> He was perceptive enough to realize that the Empire would change the state of living on Cloud City, and decided to depart as they descended on the floating settlement. Refusing to leave his favors uncalled, Yoxgit used his earlier ties with Hermi Odle to secure new jobs for himself in [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's criminal organization]]&mdash;jobs in which he acquitted himself well enough to earn Jabba's favor within a year. Thinking ahead, Yoxgit, in his final moments, believed that the killer of Jabba's murderer would be looked on favorably in the wake of the Carkoon incident, but he was unable to see that through to fruition.<ref name="db" /> During his year at Jabba's palace, he had longed to return to Bespin.<ref name="ccg" />

==Equipment==
During his time on Cloud City, Yoxgit owned a modified luxury cloud car with chrome plating that was regarded by many individuals as garish in appearance.<ref name="db" /> While he still wore clothes similar to working-class Ugnaughts on occasion,<ref name="Pigs">{{InsiderCite|138|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Pigs in Space!}}</ref> he generally wore more fashionable clothing.<ref name="db" /> His more fashionable clothing consisted of a red [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]], black [[Boot/Legends|boots]], a silver-colored belt with a black fastener, and black [[Glove/Legends|gloves]].<ref name="TPOV" /> His work attire consisted of gray [[Robe/Legends|robe]]-like garment, a dark blue apron with pockets for carrying tools,<ref name="Pigs" /> and black footwear.<ref name="Ret2">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|pack=Ugnaughts|link=POTF2ugnaughts.asp}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I pictured his ultimate end pretty clearly, and thought it was kind of a funny Star Wars moment to have him rise from the bar with a blaster ready to do dirty deeds only to get blasted where he stood by the deck gun. That's my sense of humor, I guess&hellip;|Edward M. Erdelac on Yoxgit's demise|<ref name="blog" />}}
Yoxgit was first named in ''[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]'', a [[1998]] set of cards for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="ccg" /> The name was created by pulling a handful of random titles out of a bag of [[Wikipedia:Scrabble|Scrabble]] tiles upon the suggestion of Decipher employee [[Chuck Kallenbach]].<ref name="Tweet">{{Twitter|chuckkallenbach|status/1260220613974650881|[[Chuck Kallenbach]]|quote=I claimed that you could just pull out a bunch of tiles from a Scrabble bag and get a Star Wars name. In fact, this is where we got the name Yoxgit, along with a few others.}}</ref> His card identified him as a previously unnamed Ugnaught who appeared inside Jabba the Hutt's palace and sail barge in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. However, the mask used by the actor portraying the character had already been used in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="btm">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> He was portrayed by [[Hazel Allen]] in the film.<ref name="The Allens">{{WebCite|url=http://www.convention-guests.com/html/the_allens.html|text=The Allens|accessdate=2014-01-03|work=Convention-guests.com|archivedate=20100411073022}}</ref> In [[2004]], an image of Yoxgit was used in part one of ''[[Bespin: Action Tidings]]'', a series of articles written by [[Cory J. Herndon|Cory Herndon]] on [[Wizards.com]], to represent the Ugnaught [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]], [[Ars Fivvle]].<ref name="Action">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040930bespin1|series=Bespin: Action Tidings|text=Part 1: Live From the Surface}}</ref>

===What's the Story===
{{Quote|Add to that the fact that most of his screen time is getting sozzled on the sail barge with Jabba's cronies, and I decided he was an easy money kinda guy, looking to live large and get by doing as little real work as possible.|Edward M. Erdelac on his development of Yoxgit's entry|<ref name="blog" />}}
While Yoxgit's 1998 card had provided him with a small amount of story,<ref name="ccg" /> the character's story was further fleshed out for his entry in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] by [[Edward M. Erdelac]], writing as "caledre," through StarWars.com's [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature, "[[What's The Story?]]"<ref name="db" /> In his [[Star Wars: Blogs|blog]] on StarWars.com, Erdelac briefly described his thought process for creating Yoxgit's databank entry. From Yoxgit's screen time in ''Return of the Jedi'', where Yoxgit wore different clothes from the Ugnaughts from the previous movie on Cloud City and spent most of his time drinking on the ''Khetanna'', Erdelac decided that Yoxgit was a type of individual who wanted to live well and do as little real work as possible. From this concept, he gave Yoxgit a chrome-plated cloud car. As a fan of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Miniatures]]'' game, Erdelac made Yoxgit a technician in the entry thinking that the "Ugnaught Technician" miniature from the [[The Force Unleashed (Star Wars Miniatures)|''The Force Unleashed'' set]] had the same appearance as Yoxgit, but later found out that he more resembled the "Ugnaught Demolitionist" piece<ref name="blog">{{Blog|caledre25|1|What's The Story Behind The Scenes - M-HYD Hydroponics Droid and Yoxgit}}</ref> from the [[Champions of the Force (Star Wars Miniatures)|''Champions of the Force'' set]].<ref name="Demolitionist">{{SWMiniCite|set=Champions of the Force|pack=Ugnaught Demolitionist}}</ref> In addition, Erdelac used several elements from previous "What's The Story?" entries, such as A'roFilter from [[Captain Yossarian|Benjamin Christopher Norton Dawe]]'s [[Willrow Hood/Legends|Willrow Hood]] entry, and Wam Lufba, whose entry had been written by [[Tim Veekhoven]], and which Erdelac had particularly enjoyed. In the original submission, Erdelac wrote that Yoxgit had been invited to view the execution on the ''Khetanna'' due to him installing a silent alarm on Han Solo's carbonite casing that detected Princess Leia Organa opening it, but during the editing process the reference was cut.<ref name="blog" /> The entry also did not make it clear whether his modified luxury cloud car was originally<ref name="db" /> a [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car]], such as the ones seen in ''The Empire Strikes Back'',<ref name="cloudcar">{{DB|vehicle|twinpodcloudcar|twin-pod cloud car}}</ref> or some other model.<ref name="db" />

===''The Empire Strikes Back'' retcon and further developments===
In [[2009]], an Ugnaught from ''The Empire Strikes Back'' with a similar appearance to Yoxgit albeit with a gray uniform, received a [https://www.rebelscum.com/TLCBD28Ugnaught.asp action figure] that was packaged with the controls to the carbon freezing chamber in [[Hasbro]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Legacy Collection]]'' set,<ref name="Ug1">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Legacy Collection|pack=#28: Ugnaught|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/tlcbd28ugnaught.asp}}</ref> and the Ugnaught was also pictured on the packaging of another [https://www.rebelscum.com/TLC43ugnaught1.asp Ugnaught figure].<ref name="Ug2">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Legacy Collection|pack=#28: Ugnaught|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/tlcbd28ugnaught.asp}}</ref> During [[2010]], Yoxgit was featured as an antagonist in the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] campaign of ''[[The Price of Victory]]'', the eighth set of virtual cards in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''.<ref name="TPOV" /> His card in the set was illustrated by [[Ryan Barger]].<ref name="TPoV" /> The [[2011|next year]], Yoxgit was mentioned in the Ugnaught entry of ''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'', a [[Dorling Kindersley]] reference book.<ref name="SWCE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> In [[2013]], Yoxgit was [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] to be one of the Ugnaughts from ''The Empire Strikes Back'' in [[Rogues Gallery (department)|''Rogues Gallery: Pigs in Space!'']], an article written by [[Leland Chee|Leland Y. Chee]] in ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' [[Star Wars Insider 138|''138'']]. The character retconned to be Yoxgit<ref name="Pigs" /> was one of the Ugnaughts preparing the carbon freezing chamber to be used on Han Solo.<ref name="esb" /> The retcon did introduce contradictions,<ref name="Pigs" /> since the databank entry said that Yoxgit did not mingle with Cloud City's Ugnaughts and wore different clothes.<ref name="db" /> As the character identified with Yoxgit from ''The Empire Strikes Back'' wore similar garb to other Ugnaughts and worked alongside them,<ref name="esb" /> this article was written with the assumption that the information from ''Pigs in Space!'' overrides the information presented in the databank.

From the picture identified as Yoxgit from the article, he can be identified as the same character that received an action figure in [[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] 1980 [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (toy line)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'']] toyline<ref name="Ret1">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (toy line)|pack=Ugnaught|link=VINtUgnaught.asp}}</ref> and as well as a 1998 figure in Kenner's [[Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|''Star Wars: The Power of the Force'']] set.<ref name="Ret2" /> An Ugnaught with a similar appearance to Yoxgit was in the scene where Chewbacca rescues C-3PO from being melted down, but that Ugnaught wore a gray uniform that was different from the one worn by Yoxgit.<ref name="esb" /> The 2009 Ugnaught action figure by Hasbro<ref name="Ug1" /> also cannot be confirmed as Yoxgit, due to the difference in clothing from the picture in Chee's article.<ref name="Pigs" /> The [[Tian Chyler]] card from ''The Price of Victory'' also pictured an Ugnaught with a similar appearance to Yoxgit in ''Episode V'',<ref name="Chyler">{{SWGTCG|set=The Price of Victory|cardname=Tian Chyler}}</ref> but which differed from Yoxgit's appearance in the set.<ref name="TPoV" />

A [[1980]] [[Wikipedia:Sears Canada|Sears Canada]] catalog features sets including the Kenner Ugnaught action figure but calls him "Tusk from Ugnaught."<ref name="SWCA Sears">{{WebCite|url=http://theswca.com/images-forei/canada-catalog.html|text=Sears Canada Exclusive Figures|work=Star Wars Collectors Archive|archivedate=20210120040757}}</ref> The name was apparently taken from a reference photo from [[Lucasfilm]] that had handwritten notes identifying the Ugnaught as "Tusk."<ref name="Canadian SW Gallery">{{WebCite|url=https://web.ncf.ca/cn333/esbfigs.htm|text=Empire Strikes Back Action Figures|work=The Canadian Star Wars Gallery|archivedate=20220606140707}}</ref> The final toy package simply used the same generic term as the US version.
